###### 3.2.47T Increment on transfer between Services

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">This section applies to an Officer Aviation member who transfers to another Service under section 15 of the Regulation as an Officer Aviation member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member’s Officer Aviation increment is the same as they held immediately before they transferred until they have completed the applicable of the following for their gaining Service, pathway and competency stream.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>For a member transferring to Navy or Army — platform type conversion training.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>For a member transferring to Air Force — training for Category D qualification or Air Traffic Controller primary endorsement.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">For a member transferring to Navy or Air Force, on the completion of the applicable training in subsection 2, the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>If the member’s Officer Aviation increment is below or equal to the minimum increment for their rank, gaining pathway and competency stream, their Officer Aviation increment is the minimum increment for their rank, pathway and competency stream.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>If the member's Officer Aviation increment before transfer is above the minimum increment for their rank, gaining pathway and competency stream, their Officer Aviation increment remains the same.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>If the member's Officer Aviation increment is above the maximum increment for their rank, gaining pathway and competency stream, their Officer Aviation increment is the maximum increment for their rank, gaining pathway and competency stream.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="2">Despite paragraph 3.a, a member who transfers to Navy or Air Force may have an Officer Aviation increment above the minimum increment for their rank, pathway and competency stream that is decided by the CDF, taking into consideration the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member’s experience, qualifications and skills.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The member’s previous relevant military service<i>.</i></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>Any other matters relevant to the periods of service for increment placement.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>5.</td>
<td colspan="2">For a member who transfers to Army, on the completion of type conversion training under paragraph 2.a, the member has an Officer Aviation increment for their pathway and competency stream that is decided by the CDF, having regard to the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member’s rank.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The number of years the member was in their previous Service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>The member's qualifications and experience.</td>
</tr>
</table>

##### Division 4B: Nuclear qualified submariners – advancement and deferral of increment

###### 3.2.47W Purpose

|  | This Division provides for the advancement and the deferral of an increment for a nuclear qualified submariner who is posted to a seagoing nuclear powered submarine or a shore position as part of their nuclear powered employment category training continuum. |
|---|---|

###### 3.2.47X Definitions

|  | In this Division the following apply. |
|---|---|
|  | **Anniversary date** means the date that Part B Division 3A of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, *Salaries*, applies to the member. |
|  | **Increment anniversary date** means the day that is 12 months after the member’s anniversary date or the last increment anniversary date.<br>**Note:** An advancement in increment under section B.3A.7 of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, *Salaries*, or advancement in increment that has been deferred under section 3.2.47AA does not change the member’s increment anniversary date. |
|  | **Nuclear Marine Engineer Officer Submariner** means the employment category that is paid salary under Division 3A of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, *Salaries*. |
|  | **Nuclear Powered Submarine Officer** means the employment category that is paid salary under Division 3A of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, *Salaries*. |
|  | **Nuclear Technician** means an employment category that is paid salary under Division 3A of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, *Salaries*. |

###### 3.2.47Y Member this Division applies to

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">This Division applies to a member who is in one of the following employment categories and is posted to a seagoing nuclear powered submarine or a shore position as part of their nuclear powered employment category training continuum.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Nuclear Powered Submarine Officer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Nuclear Marine Engineer Officer Submariner.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>Nuclear Technician.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.2.47Z Advance in increment

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member is to advance one increment of salary under Part 3 of Schedule B 14 of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>, on their increment anniversary date if all of the following are met.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member’s rate of salary is below the top increment for the member’s employment category.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The member ordinarily carries out duties at the standard of competence for the member’s experience.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>In the 12 months since the member’s increment anniversary date, the member has completed 12 months continuous full-time service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member is not eligible to receive more than one advancement in increment under this section in any 12 month period unless any of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>They have had an advancement deferred and then granted under section 3.2.47AA.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>They have had an advancement in increment under section B.3A.8 of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">Any period a member is not entitled to salary under section A.1.4 of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>, cannot be counted towards salary increments, unless the member is undertaking service with the United Nations.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.2.47AA Deferral of an advance in increment

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">If a member does not meet the conditions to advance in increment under paragraph 3.2.47Z.1.b, the CDF may defer the payment of an increment for up to 12 months.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">The decision to defer an increment must meet all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>It must be in writing.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>It must specify the period of deferral.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>It must be provided to the member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">A deferral decision must be reviewed by the CDF within 4 months of the date of deferral if the deferral period is greater than 4 months.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the member is assessed as having carried out their duties and responsibilities at the standard expected on review or at the end of the deferral period, the member’s increment advances by one increment on the earlier of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>At the end of the period of deferral.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>At the end of the review.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Note 1:</b> Salary at the new increment is payable from the date of the advance.<br><b>Note 2:</b> If at the end of the deferral period the member is not assessed as having carried out their duties and responsibilities at the standard expected, the member does not advance an increment.<br><b>Note 3:</b> A deferred increment under this section does not change the member’s increment anniversary date.</td>
</tr>
</table>

##### Division 4C: Cyber warfare — increment placement, advancement, transfer, promotion and deferral

###### Subdivision 1: General provisions

**3.2.47AB Purpose**

|  | This Division provides for the increment placement, advancement, transfer, promotion or deferral of a salary increment for a cyber warfare member. |
|---|---|

###### 3.2.47AC Definitions

|  | In this Division, the following apply. |
|---|---|
|  | **Anniversary date** has the meaning given in section 3.2.47AD. |
|  | **Completion of year in rank** for the purpose of increment advancement has the meaning given in section 3.2.47AO. |
|  | **Cyber warfare member** has the same meaning as provided in Part B Division 3B of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017. |
|  | **Cyber warfare officer** has the same meaning as provided in Part B Division 3B of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017. |
|  | **Cyber warfare specialist** has the same meaning as provided in Part B Division 3B of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017. |
|  | **Cyber warfare pay structure** means the pay structure provided under Part B Division 3B of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017. |
|  | **Other rank** means a member who holds a rank specified in items 14 to 21 of the table in Schedule 1 of the *Defence Act 1903*, as in force from time to time. |

###### 3.2.47AD Anniversary date

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3"><b>Anniversary date</b> means the day that is 12 months after the later of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The day the member became a cyber warfare member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the member is an officer, the day they were last promoted.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">The day the member is promoted to Able Seaman or Leading Aircraftman.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td colspan="2">The day the member is made a Private Proficient.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>e.</td>
<td colspan="2">The day the member is transferred into a different career pathway.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>f.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the member is an officer and all of the following applied immediately before they were appointed an officer, the day they are appointed as a cyber warfare officer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>They held an other rank.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>They were a cyber warfare member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>g.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member’s last anniversary date as defined in this section.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">The anniversary date under subsection 1 is extended by one day for each day that any of the following applies to the member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member is on leave without pay.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member is absent without leave.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member is not entitled to salary.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3"><b>Note:</b> The anniversary date is not changed if the member’s ‘year in rank’ is deferred.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>

###### 3.2.47AF Entry placement – general

|  | A member has the increment that corresponds with their rank and zero years in rank in their pathway when they become a cyber warfare member unless section 3.2.47AG or section 3.2.47AH applies. |
|---|---|

###### 3.2.47AG Entry placement – member transferring from another pay structure

<table>
<tr>

<td></td>

<td colspan="2">Any other relevant matters.</td>

###### Subdivision 5: Increment advancement and completion of years in rank

###### 3.2.47AN Effect of entry placement at a higher increment

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">This section applies to a member who meets all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>They entered the cyber warfare pay structure from another pay structure.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>

<td>They have been placed at an increment under section 3.2.47AG.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>

</tr>

###### 3.2.47AO Completion of year in rank

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">For the purpose of Part B, Division 3B of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, a member <b>completes a year in rank</b> if all of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">They complete one of the following in the 12 months from their last anniversary date.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>If the member is in the Permanent Forces — 12 months of service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>If the member is in the Reserves — 20 or more days of Reserve service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>If the member has served in both the Permanent Forces and the Reserves in the 12 month period — 20 days of service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The CDF has assessed the member as having carried out their duties and responsibilities at the standard expected in connection with one of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The member’s anniversary date.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>A review of the member’s performance following a deferral decision under section 3.2.47AP.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3"><b>Note:</b> A member’s increment advances when they complete a year in rank.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.2.47AP Deferral decisions

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">For the purpose of section 3.2.47AO, the CDF must assess the member as having carried out their duties and responsibilities at the standard expected.<br><b>Note:</b> A member who has been assessed as not having carried out their duties and responsibilities at the standard expected, has not completed a year in rank under section 3.2.47AO.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the CDF assesses a member as not having carried out their duties and responsibilities at the standard expected (the deferral decision), the deferral decision must meet all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Be in writing.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Specify a period of deferral.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>Be provided to the member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">The CDF must review the deferral decision at all of the following times.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>If a deferral period is greater than 4 months, within 4 months of the date of deferral.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>At the end of the period of deferral.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>At any other time within the deferral period, the CDF considers reasonable.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="2">If, on review, the member is assessed as having carried out their duties and responsibilities at the standard expected the deferral period ends.<br><b>Note 1:</b> If the member is assessed as having carried out their duties and responsibilities at the standard expected on a review, the member will advance a year in rank from the day the deferral period ends.<br><b>Note 2:</b> If at the end of the deferral period the member is not assessed as having carried out their duties and responsibilities at the standard expected, the member does not complete a year of service and stays on the same increment.<br><b>Note 3:</b> A deferred increment under this section does not change the member’s increment anniversary date.</td>
</tr>
</table>

##### Division 5: Salary non-reduction provisions

###### 3.2.48 Purpose

|  | This Division sets out the way a member's salary rate can be preserved for a period when it would otherwise be reduced. |
|---|---|

###### 3.2.49 Definitions

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">In this Division the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Relevant employment category</b> means an employment category listed in column B of tables in the following Annexes.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Annex 3.2.B – Salary non-reduction – members with the rank of Warrant Officer Class 1.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>aa.</td>
<td>Annex 3.2.C – Salary non-reduction – members with the rank of Warrant Officer Class 2 or lower.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Annex 3.2.D – Salary non-reduction – Officers.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.2.50 Member this Division applies to

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">This Division applies to a member whose salary would be reduced in one of the following circumstances.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member's Service transfers them from one employment category to another employment category.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The employment category the member holds is transferred to a lower pay grade by the DFRT.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">The employment category the member holds is restructured.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td colspan="2">The specialist career structure that the member is paid under is restructured.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>e.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member is promoted from the rank of Colonel to Brigadier, and the member was formerly in any of the following classes.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The member was formerly paid a salary for pay grade 9 or 10, derived from Part 1 or 2 of Schedule B.3 of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The member's salary was formerly derived from Schedule B.6 of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>The member's salary was formerly derived from Schedule B.7 of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iv.</td>
<td>The member's salary was formerly derived from Schedule B.8 of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.2.51 Member this Division does not apply to

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">This Division does not apply to a member whose salary would reduce in any of the following circumstances.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member's performance of duty is not satisfactory.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The member is subject to disciplinary action.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>The member is subject to administrative sanction.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td>The member chooses to transfer to another employment category.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>e.</td>
<td>The member is reduced in rank.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>f.</td>
<td>The member ceases to hold a competency that exists under the specialist career structure, for which salary was previously payable to the member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>g.</td>
<td>The Defence Force Remuneration Tribunal has determined a transitional salary structure for the member that would provide salary non-reduction for the member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>h.</td>
<td>An Other Rank member on appointment and commissioning.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.2.52 Salary non-reduction period

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">Salary is payable to a member at the rate of salary payable to them immediately before they became eligible under this Division, for a period set out in subsection 3. This is known as a salary non-reduction period.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member's non-reduction salary rate may be adjusted in accordance with the following conditions if applicable.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member may continue to be paid an annual increment of salary. The incremental rate is payable as if the pay grade or specialist career structure for which the member's salary non-reduction is payable had continued to operate.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The preserved rate (if applicable) payable to the member is adjusted in the same proportion as any general salary increase determined from time to time for the ADF by the Defence Force Remuneration Tribunal.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>A specialist officer may be taken to continue to hold a salary under a scale of rates that has previously been preserved for the specialty, if express transition or conversion arrangements are not made for the officer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">For subsection 1, the salary non-reduction period applies to a member who meets the conditions in column A of the following table for the period starting on the date in column B and ending on the date in column C.</td>
</tr>
</table>

| Item | Column A<br>Conditions | Column B<br>Start date | Column C<br>End date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | A Warrant Officer Class 1 who is in a pay grade in column A of Annex 3.2.B and holds a relevant employment category and meets any conditions specified for that category in column B. | The date listed in column C of the table in one of the following Parts of Annex 3.2.B.<br>a. If the member is in the Navy — Part 1.<br>b. If the member is in the Army — Part 2.<br>c. If the member is the Air Force — Part 3. | The earlier of the following.<br>a. The date listed in column D of the same item in Annex 3.2.B.<br>b. The day the member ceases to meet a condition specified for the relevant category. |
| 2. | A Warrant Officer Class 2 or lower who is in a pay grade in column A of Annex 3.2.C and holds a relevant employment category and meets any conditions specified for that category in column B. | The date listed in column C of the table in one of the following Parts of Annex 3.2.C.<br>a. If the member is in the Navy — Part 1.<br>b. If the member is in the Army — Part 2.<br>c. If the member is the Air Force — Part 3 | The earlier of the following.<br>a. The date listed in column D of the same item in Annex 3.2.C.<br>b. The day the member ceases to meet a condition specified for the relevant category. |
| 3. | An officer who is in a pay grade in column A of Annex 3.2.D and holds a relevant employment category in column B. | The date listed in column C of the table in one of the following Parts of Annex 3.2.D.<br>a. If the member is in the Navy — Part 1.<br>b. If the member is in the Army — Part 2.<br>c. If the member is the Air Force — Part 3. | The date listed in column D of Annex 3.2.D. |
| 4. | Not described in table item 1, 2 or 3. | The day the member becomes eligible under section 3.2.50. | The later of the following days.<br>a. After 18 months.<br>b. A day later than 18 months decided by the CDF. |

| 4. | A member's salary non-reduction period ends if the salary payable to the member under schedule B.3, B.10 or B.12 of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, *Salaries*, increases to a rate higher than the rate that is payable to the member under subsection 1. |
|---|---|

###### 3.2.52A Salary non-reduction – Air Force Flight Test Engineer

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">A member of the Air Force who was in pay grade 7 on 3 May 2006 is eligible for the rate of salary that was payable to them immediately before this Division applied to them if they meet all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member holds the rank of Squadron Leader.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">They are an Aeronautical Engineer with Flight Test Engineer qualifications.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">They are posted to or are in a designated flying position or flying-related position.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">The member’s salary non-reduction period ends on the earlier of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">Three years after the day the member ceases to be employed as a Flight Test Engineer in a designated flying position or flying-related position.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The day the member ceases to be qualified for a designated flying position or flying-related position.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">The day the member’s liability to fly has been withdrawn.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td colspan="2">The day the earlier of any of the following occurs.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The member is promoted to Wing Commander.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The member’s service in the Permanent Forces ends.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.2.53 Service during salary non-reduction period to count for certain purposes

| 1. | The member's service during a period of salary non-reduction is to be treated as service for determining rank and incremental advancement. |
|---|---|
| 2. | This section does not apply if the member’s rank or pay grade has been reduced for reasons other than those listed in section 3.2.50. |

###### 3.2.55 Retention of pay grade

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">A member who ceases to be eligible for a pay grade may continue to be paid, at the rate applicable for the member’s rank and increment in that pay grade, if all of the following circumstances are met.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The CDF determines the member remains liable to serve in the employment category and (if relevant) the classification that the pay grade related to.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The CDF approves the payment at that pay grade if it is reasonable having regard to the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>For an other rank member – whether the member holds qualifications otherwise required for payment at that pay grade, for a period of up to 3 years.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>For a Warrant Officer Class 1 – any relevant instruction or direction made under sections 9 and 10 of the <i>Defence Act 1903</i>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>For an officer – any relevant instruction or direction made under sections 9 and 10 of the <i>Defence Act 1903</i>.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.2.56 Non-reduction supplement for Other Rank members

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">A non-reduction supplement is to be paid to a member who meets all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>On any day after 23 December 2008 and before 1 July 2009, the member is paid salary at a rate higher than that payable under schedule B.10 or B.12 of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>, as amended from time to time.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The higher rate represents a rank increment or pay grade and employment category combination that ceased to exist in DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>, on 24 December 2008.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">The rate of non-reduction supplement is the difference between the rate described in paragraph 1.a and the rate payable to the member under DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>, paid to the member as all of the following amounts.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>A one-off payment for the period 24 December 2008 to 27 February 2009.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>A fortnightly payment.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">This section ceases to apply to a member from the earliest of the following days.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The day that the rate of salary payable to the member under DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>, as amended from time to time, is equal to or higher than the rate of salary payable under this section.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The day that there is a subsequent change of circumstances of the member that would end or vary the entitlement to the rank and pay grade on which the non-reduction supplement was based.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>The day the amount is replaced under a new Workplace Remuneration Arrangement by determination of the DFRT.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.2.57 Non-reduction supplement for Other Rank members of the Reserves

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">A non-reduction supplement is to be paid to a member of the Reserves who meets all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>On any day after 23 December 2008 and before 30 September 2009, the member is paid salary at a daily rate higher than that payable to the member under schedule B.10 or B.12 of DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>, as amended from time to time.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The higher rate represents a rank increment or pay grade and employment category combination that ceased to exist in DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>, on 24 December 2008.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">The rate of non-reduction supplement is the difference between the daily rate described in paragraph 1.a and the daily rate payable to the member under DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">This section ceases to apply to a member from the earliest of the following days.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The day that the rate of salary payable to the member under DFRT Determination No. 2 of 2017, <i>Salaries</i>, as amended from time to time, is equal to or higher than the rate of salary payable under this section.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The day that there is a subsequent change of circumstances of the member that would end or vary the entitlement to the rank and pay grade on which the non-reduction supplement was based.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>The day the amount is replaced under a new Workplace Remuneration Arrangement by determination of the DFRT.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.2.58 Movements between Reserve service and continuous full-time service

| 1. | This section applies to a member in receipt of a non-reduction supplement who moves between Reserve service and continuous full-time service. |
|---|---|
| 2. | For a period of continuous full-time service the member is to be paid the non-reduction supplement at the same rate payable under section 3.2.56. |
| 3. | For the period of Reserve service, the member is to be paid the non-reduction supplement at a daily rate worked out under section 3.2.57. |

#### Part 3: Bonuses

##### Division 1: General provisions

###### Subdivision 1: Interpretation

###### 3.3.1 Purpose

|  | This Part provides bonuses to attract and retain members who are capability critical to the ADF. |
|---|---|

###### 3.3.2 Definitions

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">In this Part the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Agreed period of service</b> means the number of days of effective service the member agrees to serve in connection with a bonus under this Chapter.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Bonus amount</b> means the amount of money specified in a valid offer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Bonus condition</b> means one of the following</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>If the bonus is a category A bonus, a condition specified in section 3.3.14.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>If the bonus is a category B bonus, a condition specified in section 3.3.18.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Call out order</b> means continuous full-time service under a call out order under Division 3 of Part III of the Act.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Commencement day of an agreed period of service</b> has the meaning given in section 3.3.3.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Effective service</b> has the meaning given in subdivision 2.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Valid acceptance</b> has the meaning given in section 3.3.5.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Valid offer</b> has the meaning given in section 3.3.4.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.3.3 Commencement day of an agreed period of service

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">The <b>commencement day of a member’s agreed period of service</b> is the latter of the following days.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The day specified in the offer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">If a member is under any of the following service obligations, the day after the service obligation ends.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>An initial minimum period of service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>A return of service obligation.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>An undertaking for further service under another bonus, however described, other than a bonus under Part 4.<br><b>Note:</b> This includes an undertaking for further service under Part 8 of the <i>Military Superannuation and Benefits Act 1991</i>, as preserved by item 4 of Schedule 4 <i>Defence Legislation Amendment Act (No. 1) 2005</i>.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.3.4 Valid offer

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">A <b>valid offer</b> of a bonus is an offer that meets all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">It is made on the approved form.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">It specifies that the bonus is one of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>A retention bonus.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>A completion bonus.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">It specifies the bonus condition.<br><b>Note 1:</b> The bonus condition for a category A bonus is specified in section 3.3.14.<br><b>Note 2:</b> The bonus condition for a category B bonus is specified in section 3.3.18.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td colspan="2">It specifies a bonus amount that does not exceed the amount payable that applies to the bonus category.<br><b>Note 1:</b> The maximum bonus amount for a category A bonus is specified in section 3.3.12.<br><b>Note 2:</b> The maximum bonus amount for a category B bonus is specified in section 3.3.16.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>e.</td>
<td colspan="2">It specifies an agreed period of service that is within the period that applies to the bonus category.<br><b>Note 1:</b> The agreed period of service limits for a category A bonus is specified in section 3.3.13.<br><b>Note 2:</b> The agreed period of service limits for a category B bonus is specified in section 3.3.17.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>f.</td>
<td colspan="2">It specifies an indicative day on which the member will commence serving the agreed period of service.<br><b>Note:</b> The commencement date may be altered if the member is completing an undertaking for further service in relation to another benefit, however described.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>g.</td>
<td colspan="2">If it is being made to a member of the Reserves for Reserve service, it specifies the member’s pattern of reserve service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>h.</td>
<td colspan="2">It specifies the date that the offer must be accepted by.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.3.5 Valid acceptance

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">A <b>valid acceptance</b> of an offer means an acceptance that meets all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>It is made on the approved form.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>It is made on or before a day specified in the valid offer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c</td>
<td>It includes an election on how the bonus is to be paid.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### Subdivision 2: Effective service

###### 3.3.6 Effective service – member on continuous full time service

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">This section applies to a member who meets all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>They are on continuous full-time service, other than a member of the reserves performing continuous full-time service solely for the purpose of a call out order.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>They are not subject to a flexible service determination.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member provides effective service on all of the following days.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>A day for which the member is paid salary.<br><b>Note:</b> This includes a day of paid leave.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>A day on which the member is on unpaid leave that is before the 22nd day in a period of unpaid leave.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">Despite subsection 2, a member does not provide effective service on a day in which any of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>They are in custody.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>They are in detention.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>They are imprisoned.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="2">Effective service is calculated in accordance with the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>A day for which the member receives full pay — 1 day.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>A day on which the member receives half pay — half a day.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>A day on which the member is on unpaid leave — 1 day.<br><b>Note:</b> A member ceases to provide effective service on the 21st day of unpaid leave.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.3.7 Effective service – member subject to a flexible service determination

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">This section applies to a member who is subject to a flexible service determination.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">A member provides effective service on any of the following days.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">A day in the member’s pattern of service for which the member is paid salary.<br><b>Note:</b> This includes a day of paid leave.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">A day on which the member is on unpaid leave that is before the 22nd day in a period of unpaid leave.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="3">Despite subsection 2, a member does not provide effective service on a day in which any of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">They are in custody.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">They are in detention.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">They are imprisoned.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="3">The number of days of effective service a member performs in a fortnight is calculated using the following formula and must not exceed 14 days.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">[image: Start formula effective service equals A times 1.4 end formula]</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3"><b>Where:</b></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><b>A</b></td>
<td colspan="2">is the sum of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>Each full day of duty in the member’s pattern of service in the fortnight.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>Each combination of part days of duty in the member’s pattern of service in the fortnight that add up to 8 hours.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.3.8 Effective service – member on Reserve service

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">This section applies to a member of the Reserves not on continuous full-time service, other than under a call out order.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member provides effective service on any of the following days.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>A day on which the member provides Reserve service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>A day on which the member is on call out order.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">Despite subsection 2, a member does not provide effective service on a day in which any of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>They are in custody.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>They are in detention.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>They are imprisoned.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="2">A day on which the member provides effective service is 1 day of effective service.<br><b>Note:</b> This section applies regardless of the number of hours the member serves on the day.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### Subdivision 3: Application

###### 3.3.9 Member this Part applies to

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">This Part applies to the following members.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>A member on continuous full-time service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>A member of the Reserves on reserve service.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.3.10 Member this Part does not apply to

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">This part does not apply to a member who meets any of the following on the day the offer of a bonus is made to the member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member has a Military Employment Classification of J5.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member has less than 1 year to serve until the end of the member's fixed period of service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member has less than 1 year to serve until the later of the following days.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The day the member reaches retirement age.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The last day that the member has been given a direction allowing them to serve beyond their retirement age.<br><b>Note:</b> A direction allowing a member to serve beyond their retirement age is made under section 23 of the Defence Regulation.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member has been given notice for one of the following purposes and a decision on that notice had not been made.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>Terminating the member’s service under section 101 of the Act.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>Ending the member’s service under section 24 of the Defence Regulation.</td>
</tr>
</table>

##### Division 2: Category A Bonus

###### 3.3.11 Eligibility for a category A bonus

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">A member is eligible for a category A bonus if all of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The CDF does all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>They believe the member is critical to capability.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>If making an offer to a member of the Reserves not on continuous full-time service, they are satisfied that the requirements of subsection 2 are satisfied.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>They make a valid offer for a category A bonus to the member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iv.</td>
<td>If the offer must be accepted on a date other than 28 days after the offer was made or 28 days after the day the member returns to Australia after a deployment, set a day the offer must be accepted by.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member makes a valid acceptance of the offer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">On the day of accepting the offer, the member is expected to be able to complete the agreed period of service for the bonus before any of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The last day of their fixed period of service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>If the member has not been given a direction allowing them to work beyond their retirement age, the day they reach their retirement age.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>The last day they are allowed to serve beyond the member’s retirement age.<br><b>Note:</b> A direction allowing a member to serve beyond their retirement age is made under section 23 of the Defence Regulation.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">If the member is a member of the Reserves, all of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member is able to complete the agreed period of service before the end of their period of service in the Reserve.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The capability cannot be reasonably met by any of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>A member of the Permanent Forces.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>A member of the Reserves on continuous full-time service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>A member of the Reserves on Reserve service without an offer of a bonus.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.3.12 Category A bonus – bonus amount

|  | The bonus amount for a category A bonus must not exceed $200,000. |
|---|---|

###### 3.3.13 Category A bonus – agreed period of service

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">The agreed period of service for a category A bonus must be one of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>If the member is in the Permanent Forces — a specified number of days of effective service between 1 and 5 years.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>If the member is in the Reserves — a minimum of 20 days of effective service each year for between 1 and 5 years.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.3.14 Category A bonus – bonus condition

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">The bonus condition for a category A bonus means one of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The specified position or specified role in which the member is to complete their agreed period of service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The primary skill the member must maintain during their agreed period of service.</td>
</tr>
</table>

##### Division 3: Category B Bonus

###### 3.3.15 Eligibility for a category B bonus

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">A member is eligible for a category B bonus if all of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The CDF does all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>They believe the member is in a workgroup that is critical, or at risk of being critical, to capability.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>They are satisfied that there are no inconsistencies in the application of the bonus for similar workgroups across the ADF.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>If making an offer to a member of the Reserves not on continuous full-time service, they are satisfied that the requirements of subsection 2 are satisfied.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iv.</td>
<td>They make a valid offer for a category B bonus to the member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>v.</td>
<td>If the offer must be accepted on a date other than 28 days after the offer was made or 28 days after the day the member returns to Australia after a deployment, set a date the offer must be accepted by.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member makes a valid acceptance of the offer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>

#### Part 4: Continuation bonus

##### Division 1: General provisions

###### Subdivision 1: Preliminary

###### 3.4.1 Simplified outline for this Part

This Part provides a bonus to members who have reached particular career milestones to encourage them to remain in the ADF as a member of the Permanent Forces for an additional 3 years.

An offer of a continuation bonus may be made to a member up to 2 times. Generally, an offer of continuation bonus offer 1 is made after 4 years of service (Division 2) and an offer of continuation bonus offer 2 is made after 7 years of service (Division 3). Each offer has specific conditions.

To receive a continuation bonus, an offer is generally required to be accepted by the member. Specific rules apply to who is eligible and when an offer can be accepted (Division 4).

If a member accepts an offer of a continuation bonus, they may elect to receive the continuation bonus in one payment or in 2 separate payments (Section 3.4.21).

Associated with receiving the continuation bonus is a requirement to complete an agreed period of service (Section 3.4.2, definition). This is 1095 days of effective service in the Permanent Forces, which is the equivalent of 3 years.

Rules relating to how effective service is calculated are provided in subdivision 2 of this Division.

A member may cease to be eligible to receive an unpaid portion of the bonus if they do not complete the agreed period of service associated with the continuation bonus (Section 3.4.21). In some cases, they may have to repay the amount of the continuation bonus they have received (Section 3.4.23).

<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td colspan="2">They are suspended from duty and receive salary.<br><b>Note:</b> A member suspended from duty without pay does not provide effective service as a consequence of subsection 1.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.4.7 Calculation of effective service – days not subject to a flexible service determination

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">Effective service for a day that a member is not subject to a flexible service determination is calculated in accordance with the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>A day for which the member receives full pay is 1 day of effective service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>A day on which the member receives half pay is half a day of effective service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>A day on which the member is on unpaid leave is 1 day of effective service.<br><b>Note:</b> A member who takes more than 21 consecutive days of leave without pay does not provide effective service for the entire period of leave.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.4.7A Calculation of effective service – days subject to a flexible service determination

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">Effective service for day in a fortnight that a member is subject to a flexible service determination a fortnight is calculated using the following formula and must not exceed 14 days.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">[image: Start formula effective service equals A times 1.4 end formula]</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3"><b>Where:</b></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><b>A</b></td>
<td colspan="2">is the sum of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>Each full day of duty and full day of unpaid leave, in the member’s pattern of service in the fortnight.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>Each combination of part days of duty, and part days of unpaid leave, in the member’s pattern of service in the fortnight that add up to 8 hours.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Note:</b> A member who takes more than 21 consecutive days of leave without pay does not provide effective service for the entire period of leave.</td>
</tr>
</table>

</tr>
<tr>

<td>c.</td>

<td></td>

</tr>

##### Division 5: Payment, cessation and repayment of the continuation bonus

###### 3.4.20 Eligibility for payment of the continuation bonus

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="4">A member is eligible to be paid the continuation bonus if one of the following applies.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">They have made a valid acceptance for a continuation bonus.</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">All of the following apply.</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>They were made a valid offer.</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>They have not made a valid acceptance of the offer.</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>The CDF is satisfied it is reasonable in the circumstances to pay the continuation bonus.</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">For the purpose of paragraph 1.b, the CDF must consider all of the following.</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The reason the member was offered the continuation bonus.</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The reason the member ceased to be eligible to make a valid acceptance.</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">The payment is in the interests of the ADF.</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td colspan="2">The payment meets the intent of the policy.</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.4.21 How the continuation bonus is paid

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">The continuation bonus is payable in accordance with the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the member chose to receive the continuation bonus in 1 payment — from the first payday after the later of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The commencement day specified in the valid offer.<br><b>Note:</b> If the commencement day of the agreed period of service is changed as a consequence of subsection 3.4.3.1, payment remains payable on the commencement day specified in the offer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The day a valid acceptance is made.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the member chose to receive the continuation bonus in 2 payments, the payments are made at the following times.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The first payment, being 50% of the continuation bonus — the day specified in paragraph a.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The second payment, being 50% of the continuation bonus — from the first payday a year after the first payment is made.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">If a member chose to receive the continuation bonus in 2 payments and any of the following apply, the second payment is payable from the member’s last day in the Permanent Forces.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">A decision has been made under any of the following to end the member’s service in the Permanent Forces.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>Paragraph 24(1)(a) of the Defence Regulation because of medical unfitness.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>Paragraph 24(1)(b) of the Defence Regulation because of redundancy.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member dies.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="3">A payment under this Division must not be made before 1 July 2025.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.4.22 Cessation of eligibility for the continuation bonus

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">A member ceases to be eligible for the continuation bonus if any of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">They cease to be a member of the Permanent Forces for a reason other than any of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>Paragraph 24(1)(a) of the Defence Regulation because of medical unfitness.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>Paragraph 24(1)(b) of the Defence Regulation because of redundancy.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">They die.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3"><b>Note 1:</b> The member is not required to repay any amount of the bonus received unless section 3.4.23 applies.<br><b>Note 2:</b> This subsection does not affect a member’s eligibility for an amount that is payable to the member before they cease being a member of the Permanent Forces.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.4.23 Repayment of the continuation bonus

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">This section applies to a member who has received a continuation bonus and does not complete their agreed period of service for any of the following reasons.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">They do any of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>Voluntarily transfer to the Reserves.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>Apply to change their period of service for the purpose of ending their service in the Permanent Forces before they complete their agreed period of service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">Their service ends due under any of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>Section 101 of the Act relating to a prohibited substance test returning a positive result.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>Paragraph 24(1)(c) of the Defence Regulation for a reason not in the interest of the Defence Force relating to performance or behaviour.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>Paragraph 24(1)(d) of the Defence Regulation for having engaged in sexual violence.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">They are dismissed under the <i>Defence Force Discipline Act 1982</i>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">The member must repay the amount of the continuation bonus paid to them.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Note:</b> If a member’s service ends for more than one reason and includes any of the above reasons, the member remains liable to repay the continuation bonus.</td>
</tr>
</table>

#### Part 5: Reserve capability at short-notice

##### Division 2B: Reserve capability completion bonus – capability at short‑notice

###### 3.5.14G Purpose

|  | The purpose of this Division is to provide a payment to select members of the Reserves as an incentive to provide capability at short-notice. |
|---|---|

###### 3.5.14H Member eligible for Reserve capability completion bonus

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">A member of the Reserves who meets all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member has made a written undertaking to provide capability at short-notice.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The member is assigned as service category 4 by their Service.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.5.14I Payment of the bonus

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">A member is eligible to receive a payment of $5,000 each time they satisfy all of the following criteria.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member has performed service for the minimum number of days specified in their service category 4 undertaking within 12 months.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member has completed one of the following in service category 4.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>If the CDF has extended the period under subsection 2 — the period set by the CDF.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>12 months.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member has satisfied all of the conditions specified by their service category 4 undertaking.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">The CDF may extend the period under paragraph 1.b up to a maximum of 1 year if all of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member has not met the criteria under paragraph 1.a or paragraph 1.c.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member has not completed the period specified under paragraph 1.b.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="3">For the purpose of subsection 2, the CDF must consider the reasons that have prevented the member from meeting their obligations when extending the period.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="3">A member may not receive more than one payment in a 12‑month period.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.5.14IA Recognised service

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">For the purpose of paragraph 3.5.14I.1.a, all of the following days served while the member is in service category 4 count towards the number of days specified in a member’s service category 4 undertaking.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>A day on which the member provided Reserve service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>A day on which the member is on continuous full-time service performed as a requirement of a call out order under Division 3 of Part III of the Act after 27 November 2019.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>A day in a pattern of Reserve service that the member was unable to provide because of restriction or limitation imposed by or under a law of a State or Territory, however described from 27 March 2020.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td>A day in a pattern of Reserve service the member would have provided if it had not been cancelled for the purposes of controlling an infectious disease from 27 March 2020.</td>
</tr>
</table>

<table>

#### Part 6: Deliberately differentiated offer for members

###### 3.6.1 Purpose

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">This Part has the following purposes.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">To facilitate the following outcomes.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The member who is critical to capability is retained.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>A position critical to capability is no longer at risk.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>The Defence factors that influenced the member to consider leaving the ADF are weakened.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iv.</td>
<td>A succession plan to address the workforce capability gap is implemented.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>v.</td>
<td>A critical workforce capability gap is resolved.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">To provide a selection of incentives that may be used to retain a member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">The deliberately differentiated offer is a management-initiated retention measure. Members may not apply for a deliberately differentiated offer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="3">This Part is not intended to be used as a talent or career management tool. It should not be used to address issues of equity and flexible work arrangements as targeted special measures are already available for these issues.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.6.2 Definitions

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">In this Part the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Member critical to capability</b> means a member for whom the CDF decides all the following circumstances exist.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The loss of that member would significantly impact on ADF strategic or operational capability.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The member's skills, knowledge or qualifications cannot be readily replaced in the immediate future.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>The member has demonstrated consistent high performance.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Position critical to capability</b> means a position that is essential to strategic or operational capability of the ADF and requires a particular set of skills, knowledge or qualification. Failure to fill the position impacts negatively on delivery of Service capability.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Agreed period of service</b> means the period the member has agreed to serve in the position for which the deliberately differentiated offer is made using the form at Annex 3.6.A.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Workforce capability gap</b> means the gap between the current and required capability of the workforce.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.6.3 Member this Part applies to

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="4">For this Part, the member must meet all of the following conditions.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="3">The member is one of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>A member of the Permanent Forces.</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>A member of the Reserves on continuous full-time service.</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="3">The member is a member critical to capability.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.6.4 Situations that delay service

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">A member who is offered a deliberately differentiated offer under this Part cannot start their agreed period of service if any of the following circumstances apply to them.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member is not on paid service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member is subject to an undertaking for further service under Part 8 of the <i>Military Superannuation and Benefits Act 1991</i> (as preserved by item 4 of Schedule 4 <i>Defence Legislation Amendment Act (No. 1) 2005</i>).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member has any of the following liabilities.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>An initial minimum period of service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>A return of service obligation.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>The member is on Reserve service.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.6.5 Considerations before an offer is made

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">Before deciding that a member is to be given a deliberately differentiated offer, the CDF must have regard to the following circumstances.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Whether the member has applied, or is expecting to apply, to change their period of service that has the effect of bringing forward the end of the member's service in the Permanent Forces.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Whether the member has undertaken, or is expected to undertake, a further period of continuous full-time service in the position.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>Whether the member has indicated that they are unwilling to remain in or move to a position critical to capability.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">Before deciding which benefits in this Part to include in the deliberately differentiated offer made to the member, the CDF must consider the following matters, if relevant.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Any evidence that failure to retain the member will cause a workforce capability gap.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The manner in which the current and future duties of the member support capability.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>Whether the member holds skills, knowledge or qualifications that are essential to the delivery of Service capability.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td>The required period of service to assist succession in the position.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>e.</td>
<td>The anticipated timeframe to backfill the position if the member were to leave the Permanent Forces or resign from the ADF.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>f.</td>
<td>The potential for the succession plan developed by the Service career management agency to address the position critical to capability or workforce capability gap within the agreed period of service of the deliberately differentiated offer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>g.</td>
<td>Any factors that could reduce the negative impact to capability.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>h.</td>
<td>The member's professional and personal situation, and what types of incentives would encourage the member to continue serving in the position for the agreed period of service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>Any external organisation's offer of employment to the member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>j.</td>
<td>The flexible working arrangements that the member may wish to access in the position.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>k.</td>
<td>Any other relevant matter.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.6.6 Deliberately differentiated offer

| 1. | The benefits in an individual member's deliberately differentiated offer are worked out in accordance with this section. |
|---|---|
| 2. | The deliberately differentiated offer may include any of the benefits outlined in the table below. |

| Item | The following benefit | may be made available from | until |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | Home purchase and sale assistance may be provided after the normal time period for eligibility has expired.<br>a. Reimbursement of the costs of **sale** of a home may be considered after the 2‑year time period in subsection 7.3.23.1 has lapsed.<br>b. Reimbursement of costs of **purchasing** a home may be considered after the 4‑year time period in paragraph 7.3.23.5.b has lapsed. | a date specified by CDF | the expiry of the ***agreed period of service***. |
| 2. | Removal assistance which may include a removal and associated benefits to a personal location where benefits are provided, or to another residence within location, outside the normal limits on assistance.<br>a. In circumstances other than compassionate circumstances.<br>b. Above normal cost limits. | a date specified by CDF | any of the following dates.<br>a. The expiry of the agreed period of service.<br>b. A date specified by CDF. |
| 3. | Allocation of a Service Residence or rent band choice home, at or above the member's rank and bedroom entitlement. The following conditions apply.<br>a. The higher contribution scheme at section 7.6.43 does not apply to this benefit.<br>b. The approved rent band or additional bedroom is to be specified as part of the offer. | a date specified by CDF | the earlier of the following dates.<br>a. The date the member vacates the residence.<br>b. A date specified by CDF. |
| 4. | An increased rent ceiling. The following conditions apply.<br>a. Increased rent ceiling may be provided for reasons not specified in section 7.8.12.<br>b. The ceiling may be increased up to an amount approved by CDF.<br>c. The approved rent ceiling is to be specified as part of the offer. | a date specified by CDF | the earlier of the following dates.<br>a. The date the member vacates the residence.<br>b. A date specified by CDF. |
| 5. | An additional number of trips in any of the following types of travel for which the member is currently eligible.<br>a. Reunion travel under Chapter 9 Part 3 Division 4.<br>b. Student reunion travel under Chapter 9 Part 3 Division 5.<br>c. Recreation leave travel under Chapter 9 Part 4 Division 1.<br>d. Remote location leave travel under Chapter 9 Part 4 Division 4. | the date the agreed period of service begins | any of the following dates.<br>a. The expiry of the agreed period of service.<br>b. An earlier date specified by CDF. |

Leave may be granted for up to 20 days for each 12‑month period of the agreed period of service.<br>b. The leave days are in addition to the member's normal leave accrual.<br>c. The leave is non-accruable and expires at the end of each 12‑month period.<br>d. The leave is to be recorded as if it were short absence, but is not short leave from duty. Payment instead of leave is not available for this leave. | the date the agreed period of service begins | any of the following dates.<br>a. The expiry of the agreed period of service.<br>b. An earlier date specified by CDF. |

| 3. | CDF may choose which of the benefits listed in subsection 2 are to be offered to an individual member after considering the circumstances and matters listed in section 3.6.5. |
|---|---|
| 4. | The period of each benefit is worked out using the relevant guidance in column 3 and 4 of the table in subsection 2. |
| 5. | A retention bonus may also be offered under Part 5 Division 2, Bonus Framework, at the same time as the deliberately differentiated offer. |
| 6. | The deliberately differentiated offer may set out flexible working arrangements provided by Defence. |
| 7. | CDF must notify the member of the deliberately differentiated offer using the form at Annex 3.6.A. The form must set out the benefits and the detailed dates of duration for each benefit. |

###### 3.6.7 How the offer is accepted

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member may accept the offer under this Part any time after they receive it, until the latest of the following dates.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Twenty-eight days after the day the offer is made.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>A longer period that the CDF decides is reasonable, having regard to the member’s circumstances.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">An acceptance made under this subsection must be on the form at Annex 3.6.A.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">The acceptance must include an undertaking to serve for the period of the agreed period of service, using the form at Annex 3.6.A.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 3.6.8 Member does not complete the period of agreed service

| 1. | On a day that a member ceases to complete their agreed period of service, they cease to be eligible for benefits under this Part. |
|---|---|
| 2. | The member is not required to repay the benefits in their deliberately differentiated offer if the member fails to complete the agreed period of service. |
| 3. | Despite subsection 2, if the member does not complete agreed period of service in relation to a retention bonus under Chapter 3 Part 5, they may be required to repay all or part of the retention bonus. |

<tr>
<td>2.</td>

<tr>
<td>3.</td>

I am aware that if I publish this information to others, I may make the protections provided to me by the Privacy Act ineffective.</td>
</tr>

This acceptance form, and the related parts of Defence Determination 2016/19, is the whole agreement between us about the nature of this framework. ### Chapter 4: ADF allowances and reimbursements

#### Part 1: Higher duties allowance

##### Division 1: General provisions

###### 4.1.1 Purpose

|  | Higher duties allowance may be paid to recognise a member directed to perform duties attributed to a higher rank or higher position. |
|---|---|

###### 4.1.2 Definitions

|  | In this Part, the following apply. |
|---|---|
|  | **Approver** for a person described in column A in the following table means a member described in column B or a Defence APS employee described in column C of the same item. |

<table>
<tr>
<td>Item</td>
<td>Column A<br>Member performing higher duties</td>
<td>Column B<br>Defence member</td>
<td>Column C<br>Defence APS employee</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td>A member holding a rank of Colonel or lower who meets all of the following.<br>a. The member has been directed to perform the primary duties of a position at higher rank.<br>b. The primary duties of that position are not being undertaken by another person.</td>
<td>A member holding a rank of Sergeant or higher and meets all of the following.<br>a. The member is at least one rank higher than the position in which the duty is to be performed.<br>b. The person who has been directed is in the member’s chain of command.</td>
<td>A Defence APS employee holding a classification of APS 4 or higher who has managerial or supervisory responsibility for the position in which the duty is to be performed.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td>A member holding a rank of Brigadier or higher who meets all of the following.<br>a. The member has been directed to perform the primary duties of a position at higher rank.<br>b. The primary duties of that position are not being undertaken by another person.</td>
<td>A member who has responsibility for the position in which the duty is to be performed.</td>
<td>A Defence APS employee who has managerial or supervisory responsibility for the position in which the duty is to be performed.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td>A member of the Permanent Forces who is directed to perform the primary duties of a Reserve position of a higher rank.</td>
<td rowspan="2">A member holding the rank of Brigadier or higher who has command over the member.</td>
<td rowspan="2">A Defence APS Senior Executive Service Band 1 employee or higher who has managerial or supervisory responsibility for the position in which the duty is to be performed.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td>A member in all other circumstances.</td>
</tr>
</table>

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>ASD</b> means Australian Signals Directorate.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Higher rank</b> includes any of the following for which the duties are assessed as being equivalent to a rank higher than that held by the member directed to perform duties at a higher rank.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>An APS position.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>An ASD position.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>A Foreign Service rank.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">A <b>salary non-reduction arrangement</b> means one of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member’s salary rate has been preserved under Division 5 of Part 2 of Chapter 3.<br><b>Note:</b> Division 5 of Part 2 of Chapter 3 provides the way a member's salary rate can be preserved for a period when it would otherwise be reduced.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The member’s salary rate has been set under Division 4A of Part 2 of Chapter 3.<br><b>Note:</b> Division 4A of Part 2 of Chapter 3 provides the increment placement, progression and transfer through the Officer Aviation Pay Structure for an Officer Aviation member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>The member’s salary rate has been set under section B.2.5 of DFRT Determination 2 of 2017.<br><b>Note:</b> Section B.2.5 sets the salary rate for an officer who held an enlisted rank immediately before becoming an officer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td>The member’s salary rate has been set under Division 4C of Part 2 of Chapter 3.<br><b>Note:</b> Division 4C of Part 2 of Chapter 3 provides the increment placement, advancement and transfer through the Cyber Warfare Pay Structure for a Cyber Warfare member.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 4.1.3 Member this Part applies to

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">This Part applies to a member, including a member of the Reserves, who meets all of the following criteria.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member is performing duties attributed to a higher rank.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The member has been directed to perform the higher duties.</td>
</tr>
</table>

Officer aviation member in another pathway or non-specialist pathway.<br>b. Officer aviation member in the Army or Navy.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>A statutory office holder.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>

|---|---|---|
