|---|---|

###### 6.1.7 Number of current removal

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">The <b>number of a member’s current removal</b> means one of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>If the member is not part of a dual service couple — the number of removals, including the current removal, for which the member has been eligible for disturbance allowance since they last began continuous full-time service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>If the member is part of a dual serving couple and they move together — the number of removals, including the current removal, of the member who has the greater number of removals since they began continuous full-time service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Note:</b> If a member re-enters the ADF after a break in service, the number of removals restarts. Their first removal is not added to the number of removals in their previous period of service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">For the purpose of subsection 1, if a member, their resident family and recognised other persons are removed separately to the same location, the removal is treated as 1 removal.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.1.8 Resident family removed at a later date

| 1. | A member who is removed without their resident family is eligible for an amount equal to the amount payable to a member under subsection 6.1.6.1 table item 2. |
|---|---|
| 2. | If the member’s resident family are removed to the same location as the member at a later date, the total amount payable for both removals must not be more that if they had been removed together. |

###### 6.1.9 Removal on enlistment

|  | A member who has no resident family and is granted a removal on enlistment is eligible for an amount equal to the amount payable to a member under subsection 6.1.6.1 table item 2. |
|---|---|

###### 6.1.10 Removal and storage on posting overseas – number of removal

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">This section applies to a member who meets all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">They receive a posting order for a long-term posting overseas.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">They choose to store their furniture and effects in a storage facility in Australia.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">For the purpose of disturbance allowance under subsection 6.1.6.1, all of the following removals of the member’s and resident family’s furniture and effects are counted as a single removal.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">A removal from any of the following locations to a storage facility in Australia.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The member’s housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The family benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">A removal from the storage facility to any of the following locations on return from their long-term posting overseas.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The member’s new housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The new family benefit location.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.1.11 Death of a member

|  | If a member dies and their resident family or recognised other persons are granted a removal, the resident family or recognised other persons are eligible for an amount of disturbance allowance. The amount is what the member would have been paid if the removal had been granted on ceasing continuous full-time service. |
|---|---|

###### 6.1.12 A child changing school – additional payment

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member is eligible for an additional payment of $297.00 for each child if all of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member’s child is required to change schools because of a removal.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The child is a full-time student at a primary or secondary school.<br><b>Note:</b> This does not include a child at a preschool.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the child’s change of school is postponed to a later date, payment will only be made on the date they change school.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the member’s partner is also a member, only one member is eligible for the payment in respect of the child.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.1.13 Telephone installation or reconnection costs

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">A member eligible for disturbance allowance for a removal may be eligible for assistance with costs of installing or reconnecting a private telephone in the dwelling they move to. They qualify if any of the following are met.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">They had a private telephone disconnected from their former dwelling when they were removed from it.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">They had a private telephone disconnected from another earlier dwelling when they were removed from it. Since that earlier removal, they continuously occupied a dwelling where any of the following were met.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>A telephone was provided.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>They were on long-term posting overseas.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">The member may be reimbursed the cost of the installation or reconnection service, up to a maximum of $299.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.1.14 Private vehicle transfer costs

| 1. | A member is eligible for assistance with the costs of transferring a private vehicle registration to another State or Territory. The vehicle may belong to the member, their resident family or a recognised other person. |
|---|---|
| 2. | The benefit is an amount up to $63 for each removal. It is for 1 private vehicle only. It is to assist with fees and costs for registration plates, roadworthiness inspection, administration fees and ownership tests. It is not to assist with the registration fee for the vehicle. |

###### 6.1.15 Payment in special circumstances

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member may qualify for an allowance or reimbursement under this Part even if they do not meet one or more of the criteria for qualification.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">The CDF may approve payment if all of the following are satisfied.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member does not qualify for reasons beyond their control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Paying an amount is consistent with the purpose of the allowance.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">The CDF cannot approve an amount greater than the member would have received if they had been eligible for an allowance or reimbursement.</td>
</tr>
</table>

##### Division 2: Childcare costs on removal

###### 6.1.16 Purpose

|  | A member may be eligible for assistance with the costs of childcare when they are being removed. This Division outlines conditions and amounts payable. |
|---|---|

###### 6.1.16A Member this Division does not apply to

|  | This Division does not apply to a member who is eligible for a removal under Part 5 Division 10. |
|---|---|

###### 6.1.17 Members eligible

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">A member granted a removal is eligible for assistance with childcare costs on removal if all of the following are met.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member’s child is resident family or a recognised other person and meets any of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>Is under 11 years old.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>Has a disability.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">They must pay for the childcare.<br><b>Note:</b> The childcare is not limited to recognised government or commercial day care facilities.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">For family, Service or medical reasons, only the member or 1 adult who is recognised as resident family or as a recognised other person is able to help with the removal.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">Medical reasons in paragraph 1.c include an adult who is recognised as resident family or as a recognised other person being unable to help with the removal because they have a medical condition. This must be supported by a medical certificate.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="3">For the purpose of paragraph 1.c, family reasons include any of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">If any of the following are unable to help with the removal because of work commitments they cannot avoid.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The member’s partner.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>An adult who is resident family or a recognised other person.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member is a single parent who has no adults recognised as resident family or recognised other persons that can help with the removal.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member, their partner or an adult who is resident family or as a recognised other person is absent to care for their close family member who is ill.<br><b>Note:</b> Claims should be supported by a medical certificate.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3"><b>Note:</b> Section 1.6.1 applies to this section and may affect the payment of assistance if a member and an adult who is recognised as resident family are both eligible for assistance with childcare costs on removal for the same period.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.1.18 Location of assistance

|  | The assistance is payable for childcare at the new or the old location. |
|---|---|

###### 6.1.19 Amount of assistance

|  | The member is eligible for a maximum of $47.40 a day. This is payable for up to 2 days of childcare per move for each eligible child who is resident family or a recognised other person. This means 2 days in total. It does not mean a maximum of 2 days at each of the new and old locations. |
|---|---|

##### Division 3: Pet relocation

###### 6.1.20 Purpose

|  | This Division provides members with assistance towards the cost of relocating pets in Australia.<br>**Note:** Pet relocation benefits for a member who has died are provided in Chapter 6 Part 5 Division 11 Subdivision 3. |
|---|---|

###### 6.1.21 Pet relocation

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">Subject to section 6.1.23, a member is eligible for the cost of relocating a pet if the CDF is satisfied that the costs are reasonable having regard to subsection 2.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>1A.</td>
<td colspan="3">A relocation under subsection 1 is between the following locations.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the member is posted within Australia — from the member’s losing location to their gaining location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the member is posted to an external territory or Thursday Island for more than 6 months — from the member’s losing location to one of the following locations.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The posting location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>A location within Australia chosen by the member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the member is posted from an external territory or Thursday Island to a location within Australia — from the location to which the pet was removed under paragraph b to the member’s gaining location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">The CDF must consider all these criteria.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The circumstances of the posting, removal and accommodation of the member and any resident family or recognised other persons.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The nature and number of the pets to be relocated.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">The arrangements to transport and board the pets.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td colspan="2">The availability of discounted transport rates to the member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>e.</td>
<td colspan="2">Any relevant information the member provides about why they own the animal. This includes information satisfying the CDF that the pets are not owned mainly for commercial or economic purposes.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>f.</td>
<td colspan="2">The time taken for travel between the former and new locations. Only the time taken for travel between housing benefit locations will be considered. This does not include time spent travelling to or from recreation leave between postings.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="3">In this section, <b>pet relocation</b> means the commercial transportation and boarding of a household pet by a service provider who meets all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">They have an Australian Business Number.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">They conduct a business for profit in the transportation or boarding of household pets.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">They are registered or licenced to carry out the business, as required under relevant State or Territory law.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="3">The benefit provided under subsection 1 may be paid in any of the following circumstances.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">Before the pet is relocated — if the member provides a quote or invoice from the service provider for the proposed services.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">After the pet is relocated — by reimbursement if the member provides a receipt for the services provided.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>5.</td>
<td colspan="3">If the benefit is provided before the pet is relocated, all of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member must provide a copy of the receipt within 21 days of the benefit being provided.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member must repay the benefit if they do not provide a copy of the receipt within 21 days of the benefit being provided.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member must repay the amount of the benefit not used for the pet relocation of the pet if any of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The pet relocation does not occur.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The cost of the pet relocation is less than the benefit provided.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.1.22 When costs may be reimbursed – member posted overseas

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">If a member is posted overseas the CDF may reimburse the following costs, if satisfied that they are reasonable.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The commercial transportation of 1 or more household pets to a location within Australia.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The boarding costs of 1 or more household pets for the period the member is in receipt of temporary accommodation allowance in the losing housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">In deciding whether costs are reasonable, the CDF must consider all the criteria in subsections 6.1.21.2 and 6.1.21.3.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.1.23 Limitations on pet relocations

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">The cost of a pet relocation does not include the costs for any of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The purchase of any of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>Equipment or other items used in the transportation or boarding of the pet.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>Goods or services for the continued use, including pet containers and vaccinations.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">A pet that is mainly used for economic or business purposes.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">The costs of non-commercial transport or boarding of the pet.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">If all of the following apply, the maximum cost of the pet relocation is the cost that would have been incurred if the pet were relocated to the member’s posting location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member is posted to an external territory or Thursday Island.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The pet is relocated to a location chosen by the member.</td>
</tr>
</table>

#### Part 2: Loss on sale of furniture, effects and private vehicles

###### 6.2.1 Purpose

|  | This Part provides members with a reimbursement when they experience a financial loss associated with the sale of furniture, private vehicles, or other effects when they are relocated.<br>**Note:** Furniture and effects is defined in section 6.1A.2. |
|---|---|

###### 6.2.1AA Member this Part does not apply to

|  | This Part does not apply to a member who is eligible for a removal under Part 5 Division 10. |
|---|---|

###### 6.2.1A Loss on items obtained through a grant

|  | A member is not eligible for reimbursement under this Part for a financial loss associated with the sale of an item obtained through a grant. |
|---|---|

###### 6.2.2 Furniture and effects – loss on sale

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">A person who meets any of the following is eligible for the reimbursement of the financial loss on the sale of furniture and effects if they choose to sell the items instead of having them removed to another location in Australia.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>A member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>A person recognised as resident family of a deceased member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>A person recognised as a recognised other person of a deceased member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">A reimbursement under this section is only payable to one person.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Note:</b> Section 1.6.1 applies to this section and may affect the reimbursement provided if a member and an adult who is recognised as resident family are both eligible for reimbursement for loss on the sale of the same furniture and effects.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.2.3 Furniture and effects – amount of reimbursement

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">Subject to this section, the amount of reimbursement is the difference between what the member gets for the sale and the sum of these two amounts.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The current market value of the furniture and effects.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The incidental costs of selling the furniture and effects.<br><b>Note:</b> Incidental costs are the standard charges of auctioneers and valuers, and reasonable advertising costs.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">The amount of reimbursement must not be more than what the Commonwealth would pay to remove the furniture and effects.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the member stores furniture and effects at Commonwealth expense and then sells them, the amount of reimbursement is reduced by the cost of the storage. If the cost of storage is greater than the loss, the member does not have to pay the Commonwealth the difference.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="2">The amount is not to be reduced under subsection 3 in these circumstances.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>It would cost more than the value of the reimbursement to continue to store the furniture and effects if they were not sold.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>By reason only of postings that do not attract a removal, the member would not use the furniture and effects within 12 months of becoming eligible for the reimbursement.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.2.4 Private vehicles – loss on sale

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">This section applies in relation to any of the following vehicles.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">A private vehicle that a member is (or would have been) eligible for removal to another location in Australia.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">One private vehicle and one towable item owned by a member who meets all of the following conditions.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>They are a member who has unaccompanied resident family and no accompanied resident family, or a member with no resident family or recognised other persons.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>They are deployed for 6 months or longer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>They have made a choice to vacate their accommodation under subsections 7.4.23.2, 7.6.38.2, 7.8.31.2, section 7.7.11, or the CDF has decided that the member must leave the living-in accommodation under subsection 7.4.23.5.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iv.</td>
<td>They have not put the vehicle or towable item in storage.<br><b>Note:</b> Storage includes on a Defence base or in non-commercial storage.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">A person may choose to sell the vehicle instead of having it removed. They are eligible for reimbursement if they make a financial loss on the sale. In this subsection vehicle means a private vehicle or a registered item that can be towed.<br><b>Note:</b> A member who is posted overseas is not eligible for reimbursement under this section.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="3">The benefit is available to any of these persons.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member on continuous full-time service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">A former member who was on continuous full-time service and is eligible for a removal of a vehicle when they complete their service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">A person legally entitled to own the vehicle of a deceased member who was on continuous full-time service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3"><b>Note:</b> Section 1.6.1 applies to this section and may affect the reimbursement provided if a member and an adult who is recognised as resident family are both eligible for reimbursement for loss on the sale of the same vehicle.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.2.5 Private vehicles – amount of reimbursement

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">The amount of reimbursement for a vehicle described in paragraph 6.2.4.1.a is the lesser of the following two amounts.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The cost to remove the vehicle if it were removed under Chapter 6 Part 5.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The difference between the valuation and the amount of the sale price after reasonable incidental costs have been deducted from it.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">The amount of reimbursement for a vehicle or towable item described in paragraph 6.2.4.1.b or 6.2.4.1.c is the lesser of the following two amounts.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The cost to store the vehicle for the period of the member’s deployment if it were stored under Chapter 6 Part 5.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The difference between the valuation and the amount of the sale price after reasonable incidental costs have been deducted from it.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">In subsections 1 and 2, valuation means a commercial valuation by a member of a recognised motor trades organisation.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="2">For the purposes of subsection 1, the CDF must be satisfied of all of the following when considering that the person made reasonable efforts to sell the vehicle without making a loss.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>When and how widely the person advertised the vehicle for sale.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>How the person tried to sell the vehicle.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>The nature and extent of offers made for the vehicle.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td>The particulars of the sale.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>e.</td>
<td>Any other relevant aspect of the sale.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>5.</td>
<td colspan="2">In the case of a deceased member (see paragraph 6.2.4.3.c), the amount depends on where the vehicle is to go. Payment is for the cost of transporting the vehicle to the relevant place listed below.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Within the location where the vehicle is already.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The location of the last permanent residence of the member, their resident family or a recognised other person when they enlisted or were appointed.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>A specific place if the member was enlisted or appointed from outside Australia.</td>
</tr>
</table>

#### Part 3: Travel for removal purposes in Australia

###### 6.3.1 Purpose

|  | This Division provides members with travel benefits to assist with the uplift and unpack of their furniture and effects in connection with a removal under Chapter 6 Part 5 to return to the member’s old housing benefit location to accompany their resident family and recognised other persons to their housing benefit location. |
|---|---|

###### 6.3.2 Member this Part applies to

|  | This Part applies to a member who is eligible for a removal under Chapter 6 Part 5. |
|---|---|

###### 6.3.2A Member this Part does not apply to

|  | This Part does not apply to a member who is eligible for a removal under Part 5 Division 10. |
|---|---|

###### 6.3.3 Uplift travel benefits

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">A member is eligible for vehicle allowance calculated under section 9.6.25 for the return travel between their housing benefit location and their previous housing benefit location if all of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The purpose of returning to the pervious housing benefit location is any of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>To supervise the uplift of furniture and effects at their previous housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>To accompany their resident family to the member’s housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member has commenced duty in their primary service location before their removal from their previous housing benefit location commences.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3"><b>Note 1:</b> A member may only receive this benefit once for each removal.<br><b>Note 2:</b> A member may be eligible for flights under section 9.2.10.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.3.4 Unpack travel benefits

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">A member is eligible for vehicle allowance calculated under section 9.6.25 for return travel between their housing benefit location and their new housing benefit location if all of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The purpose of the travel is to arrange accommodation and to supervise the unpacking of furniture and effects.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The member’s removal is to be delivered to their home in their new housing benefit location before they begin duty in the location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Note 1:</b> A member may only receive this benefit once for each removal.<br><b>Note 2:</b> A member may be eligible for flights under section 9.2.11.</td>
</tr>
</table>

#### Part 5: Removals and storage

##### Division 1: General provisions

###### 6.5.3 Purpose

|  | This Division gives an overview of eligibility for assistance with removal and storage in Australia. |
|---|---|

###### 6.5.4 CDF approved removal

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member or their resident family who are not eligible for a removal under a Division listed in subsection 2, is eligible for a removal under this Part if the CDF is satisfied that any of the following apply to the member, their resident family or recognised other persons.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The safety or welfare of the member, their resident family or recognised other persons would be at high risk if they stayed in their accommodation.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>A change in family circumstances requires urgent action.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>The removal is necessary to prevent an emergency from happening.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td>The member has specific housing needs during rehabilitation or as a result of an acquired injury.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>e.</td>
<td>Division 10, Assistance on breakdown of relationship.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">For the purpose of subsection 1, the Divisions are as follows.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Division 4, Posting or deployments.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Division 6, Removal on ceasing continuous full-time service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>Division 8, When a member becomes a member who has accompanied resident family or recognised other persons</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td>Division 9, When a member ceases to be a member who has resident family or recognised other persons</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>e.</td>
<td>Division 11, Removal on death of a member.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.4A Member of the Reserves eligible for a removal

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">A member of the Reserves is eligible for a removal on the following occasions.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>When they are to begin continuous full-time service on a posting of more than 6 months.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>When they cease continuous full-time service that was for a period of more than 6 months.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.5 Members not eligible for a removal

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">A member is not eligible for a removal in any of the following circumstances.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">They are posted outside of the normal posting cycle because of a voluntary exchange of postings.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member is posted to a new primary service location and their current home is already in their new housing benefit location, unless they are required to move to another home by their Service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td colspan="2">Any of the following is revoked at the member’s request.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>Extended housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>Alternate located work agreement.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>e.</td>
<td colspan="2">They are on a flexible service determination and choose to vacate their accommodation during their nonworking period.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>f.</td>
<td colspan="2">They are on a flexible service determination and all of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>They had previously chosen to vacate their accommodation during a nonworking period.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The member returns to accommodation at the housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>h.</td>
<td colspan="2">They require a removal within their housing benefit location and any of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>Before becoming a flexible housing trial member, they had a removal to their housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>They cease to be a flexible housing trial member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Note:</b> A member may become a flexible housing trial member under section 7.1.15.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.6 When a member’s partner is resident family and a member

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">If a member’s partner is also a member and both have the same housing benefit location, one of the following applies.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>If both members are eligible for a removal to the housing benefit location under Part 5, only one member is eligible for the removal.<br><b>Note:</b> The removal is for the member and their resident family and other recognised other persons.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>If the members are posted to adjacent housing benefit locations, all benefits apply to the location they choose to establish the family home.</td>
</tr>
</table>

##### Division 2: Removal of furniture and effects

###### 6.5.8 Purpose

|  | This Division sets out what will and will not be removed. |
|---|---|

###### 6.5.9 Removal of portable household items

|  | A member is eligible to have their portable household items removed if they are furniture and effects normally used for domestic purposes. |
|---|---|

###### 6.5.9A Compensation for loss or damage to items removed or stored

|  | The CDF may provide a scheme to compensate members for loss or damage to furniture or effects removed or stored under this Part.<br>**Note:** Compensation may be in the form of repair, replacement or payment. |
|---|---|

###### 6.5.10 Limitations on removals

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">The removal of the following items is limited by the specified conditions.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">A small boat, canoe, kayak or other small watercraft must be no longer than 5.7m and no heavier than 51kg.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">A larger boat capable of being carried on a trailer must be a towable item.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">A lawn locker or tool shed that must be dismantled and packed securely by the member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td colspan="2">A motor bike, trail bike or mini-bike must meet all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>It has been drained of all petrol and oil.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>It has been packed and crated by the member.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.11 Items not removed

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">An item that is not portable and meets all of the following will not be removed.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>It requires a crew of more than two people to move it, after dismantling if required.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Additional equipment, such as a crane or forklift, is needed to move it.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">Items of the following types will not be removed.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Dangerous items.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Anything living, excluding pets.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>Irreplaceable items.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td>Bulk fuel and building items.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>e.</td>
<td>Hard to trace items.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.12 Additional removal – urgently required items

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">This section applies to a member who is eligible for a removal of their furniture and effects under this Part.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member is eligible for an additional removal of essential household items if the CDF is satisfied of all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>They are required to be removed before the majority of a member’s furniture and effects.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>They will be urgently required at the member’s new location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">An <b>additional removal</b> is a removal by one of the following means.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>A removal by a Commonwealth removalist.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>If the CDF is also satisfied that a privately arranged removal is the most cost‑effective within the required time frame — a privately arranged removal.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="2">If subsection 3.b applies, the member is reimbursed the cost of the privately arranged removal.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.12A Insurance for urgently required household items

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">A person who is one of the following may be reimbursed an amount if they insure urgently required household items that are to be removed.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>A member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>A person recognised as resident family of a deceased member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>A person recognised as a recognised other person of a deceased member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">All of the following must be met.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Removal of the items is granted under section 6.5.12.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The member, their resident family or recognised other persons insures the items for the purpose of the removal.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">The amount reimbursed is the amount paid for the insurance up to the greater of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>$150.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>2% of the sum insured.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2"><b>Note:</b> Section 1.6.1 applies to this section and may affect the reimbursement provided if a member and an adult who is recognised as resident family are both eligible for the reimbursement for the cost of insurance on the removal of the same urgently needed household items.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.13 Hire of replacement household items

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">An item of furniture or effects may be lost or damaged beyond use during a removal. If this happens, a member is eligible for the reimbursement of the cost of hiring a replacement item while they wait for a decision on an indemnity or insurance claim. They are eligible for the reimbursement of hiring costs if all of the following are met.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The item was removed under this Part.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The item was useable at uplift.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>The item was packed by the approved removalist.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td>The missing or damaged item is an essential household item.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>e.</td>
<td>The loss or damage is reported to the Commonwealth removalist at the new location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>f.</td>
<td>A replacement item is not available from local Service sources.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">The eligibility ends when any of the following happens.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The original item is delivered or repaired.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The member is given a payment to replace the item.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member may be reimbursed the costs of using a laundromat washing machine and dryer if all of the following are met.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Their washing machine is lost or damaged during a removal.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>They cannot hire a suitable replacement machine at the gaining location.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.14 Technical help for dismantling and installing items

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member is eligible for the reimbursement of reasonable labour costs for technical help to dismantle and reinstall some items if it is not reasonable for the member, their resident family or recognised other persons to dismantle or reinstall the items.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member may only be reimbursed for installation of an item if it was dismantled in a previous removal.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member is not to be reimbursed under this section for the cost of any major alterations to windows or building structures.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="2">To be reimbursed, the member must do all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Get any necessary approvals from relevant authorities. This includes landlords, the Commonwealth removalist and local councils.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Give the Commonwealth removalist a receipt from the service provider when the work is done.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.15 Removal taken as privately arranged removal

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">Subsections 2 and 3 apply if all of the following are met.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member is eligible for a removal under this Part and takes the removal as a privately arranged removal.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The CDF is satisfied the privately arranged removal is because of one of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>Personal reasons.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>Service reasons that urgently require the member to move.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">The member is eligible for reimbursement of one of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the privately arranged removal is carried out by a commercial removal company — the lesser of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The amount of the removal had it been carried out by a Commonwealth removalist.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The actual cost of the privately arranged removal.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the privately arranged removal is not carried out by a commercial removal company — any of the following that the CDF is satisfied are reasonable.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The costs of hire of, and fuel for, a suitable removal vehicle.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>Vehicle allowance for use of a private vehicle for the distance between the old and the new locations, up to the amount payable under Division 5 of Part 6 of Chapter 9.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3"><b>Note:</b> To avoid doubt, a member who arranges their removal privately under this section is taken to have used their removal benefit under this Part.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="3">If the member’s accommodation at the new location is temporarily unavailable and all of the following apply, they are eligible for reimbursement of the cost of storage.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">Their items would have been stored at no cost to them had their items been removed by the Commonwealth removalist.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The CDF is satisfied that storing the member’s items is reasonable in the circumstances.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.17 Unused removal benefit

|  | A member may choose not to take up a removal benefit during a period of posting. This does not affect their eligibility for the next posting. They cannot add an unused benefit to their eligibility on a future posting. |
|---|---|

##### Division 3: Removal to or from a family benefit location

###### 6.5.18 Purpose

|  | This Division provides benefits to a member to assist their resident family and other recognised persons to move to or from a family benefit location. |
|---|---|

###### 6.5.18A Member this Division applies to

|  | This Division applies to a member who has resident family. |
|---|---|

###### 6.5.19 Compassionate removal to a family benefit location

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">A member is eligible for a removal under Division 2 for their resident family and recognised other persons to a family benefit location if the CDF is satisfied of all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member has substantial compassionate reasons for the removal.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">That the removal is in the interests of the ADF.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">For the purpose of subsection 1, the CDF must consider all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The seriousness of the reasons for the compassionate removal.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The nature of care or assistance required by the member’s resident family or the following recognised other persons.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>An adult child.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>A person recognised under paragraph 1.3.37.d.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">Whether the circumstances are likely to be resolved after a reasonably short period of time or are enduring.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td colspan="2">Whether the issue can only be addressed by relocating the member’s resident family and recognised other persons.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>e.</td>
<td colspan="2">Whether the decision to relocate was prompted by personal or Service-related circumstances.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>f.</td>
<td colspan="2">Whether the member has applied for discharge and is eligible for a discharge removal.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.19A Removal to a family benefit location for employment or study

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member is eligible for a removal under Division 2 for their resident family and recognised other persons to a family benefit location if the CDF is satisfied of all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The move is necessary for the member's partner to undertake specified employment, other than home based employment, or a specified period of face-to-face study in the family benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The move occurs within 3 months before or after a member’s move to a new housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>The member will be in the new housing benefit location for 6 months or more.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td>The family benefit location is closer to the member's housing benefit location than the former housing benefit location or family benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member may have the period under paragraph 1.b extended if the CDF considers it is reasonable in the circumstances.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">A removal granted under subsection 1 is subject to all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The removal for the member is a limited removal for the member from the former housing benefit location to the new housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The removal for the resident family is a removal of the member’s household furniture and effects from the former housing benefit location to the family benefit location.<br><b>Note:</b> The member’s household furniture and effects are not moved to the member’s new housing benefit location before being removed to the family benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="2">A removal under this section is limited to what the member would have been eligible for under this Part to move their household furniture and effects to their new housing benefit location from all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member's residence in the losing housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Any location where the member has goods stored under this Part.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>5.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member must pay any costs above the amount Defence would have paid for a removal to a family benefit location for employment or study.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>6.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the cost of removal to a family benefit location for employment or study is less than the cost of a removal to the member's new housing benefit location, the member is not eligible for the difference.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.20 Removal to a family benefit location instead of a housing benefit location in a remote location

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member is eligible for a removal under Division 2 for their resident family and recognised other persons if all of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member is posted to a remote location for 6 months or more.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The remote location is the member’s housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>The resident family choose to move to a family benefit location instead of the remote location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member in a situation set out in column A of the following table is eligible for the removal benefit provided in column B and must pay the amount set out in column C of the same item.</td>
</tr>
</table>

| Item | Column A<br>Member’s situation | Column B<br>Removal Benefit | Column C<br>Amount payable by the member |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | All of the following apply.<br>a. The removal is of items that would have been removed to the remote location.<br>b. The removal is from the member's residence and store in the previous housing benefit location to the family benefit location. | A removal under Division 2. | The difference between the following costs.<br>a. The amount it would have cost to remove the member’s resident family to the member's housing benefit location.<br>b. The amount it cost the member’s resident family to relocate to the family benefit location. |
| 2. | All of the following apply.<br>a. The removal is of items that would not have been removed to the remote location.<br>b. The removal is to the Commonwealth removalist's store. | A removal to the Commonwealth removalist’s store. |  |
| 3. | All of the following apply.<br>a. The removal is of the member's effects, without furniture.<br>b. The removal is to the family benefit location | A removal under Division 2. | The difference between the following costs.<br>a. The amount it would have cost to remove the member’s resident family to the member's housing benefit location.<br>b. The amount it cost the member’s resident family to relocate to the family benefit location. |

<table>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member is eligible for storage of items when any of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member has excess items that are not removed from the previous housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The member has items already in store at the time the posting authority is issued.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.21 Removal to family benefit location on seagoing posting

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">A member is eligible for a removal of their resident family and recognised other persons from the member’s housing benefit location to a family benefit location within Australia if all the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member is posted to any of the following for a period greater than 6 months.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>A seagoing ship.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>A seagoing submarine.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>A seagoing flight.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The CDF is satisfied the family benefit location is beneficial to the member or their resident family and recognised other persons after considering all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The availability of family or community support at the family benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The employment or education needs of the member's resident family and recognised other persons.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>Any other factor relevant to the welfare of the member's resident family and recognised other persons.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">The removal must be undertaken within 3 months before or 3 months after the member's posting date.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="3">The CDF may extend the removal period under subsection 2 if it is considered reasonable in the circumstances.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.22 Removal of resident family to a member’s housing benefit location

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">This section applies to a member who meets all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>A member's resident family do not live with the member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The resident family wish to rejoin the member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member who meets the criteria set out in column A of the following table is eligible for the removal benefit in column B and must pay the amount in column C of the same item.</td>
</tr>
</table>

| Item | Column A<br>Criteria | Column B<br>Removal Benefit | Column C<br>Amount payable by the member |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | The member was provided a full removal for their resident family and recognised other persons. | A removal under Division 2 to their housing benefit location. |  |
| 2. | The member was provided a limited removal for their resident family and recognised other persons. | A removal under Division 2 to their housing benefit location. | The difference between the following costs.<br>a. The amount it would have cost to remove the member’s resident family to the housing benefit location.<br>b. The amount it cost the member’s resident family to relocate to the family benefit location. |

| 3. | Despite subsection 2, a member is eligible for the full costs of the removal if the CDF is satisfied that it is in the interests of the ADF having regards to the direct and indirect costs of the removal. |
|---|---|

##### Division 4: Removal on commencing posting or deployment

###### 6.5.24 Purpose

|  | This Division sets out a member’s eligibility for a removal when they are posted, have an alternate work location agreement or on deployment. |
|---|---|

###### 6.5.24A Definitions

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3"><b>Cost of a removal</b> under this Division includes the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The cost of removing furniture and effects under Division 2 for any of the following people being removed.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>The member.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The member’s resident family.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>The member’s recognised other persons.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">All of the following in connection with the removal.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>Vehicle removal assistance payable to the member under Part 5A.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The cost of removal travel for the member, resident family and recognised other persons under Chapter 9 Part 2 Division 3.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>The cost of travel on posting for the member, resident family and recognised other persons under Chapter 9 Part 2 Division 4.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.25 Resident child carer does not attract any benefit

|  | If a member eligible for a removal under this Division has a resident child carer, the resident child carer's furniture and effects are not removed or stored. |
|---|---|

###### 6.5.26 Posting of 6 months or more

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member is eligible for a removal if all of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member is issued a new posting order for a period of 6 months or more.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>They have a posting order that would require them to move outside of their current housing benefit location.</td>

<tr>
<td>2.</td>

<td></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member must pay a contribution towards the cost of the removal if the cost of the removal to the new housing benefit location is greater than the cost of the removal from their housing benefit location to their service location to which they have been posted.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="2">The contribution is calculated using the following formula.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">[image: Start formula contribution equals A minus B end formula]</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">Where:</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><b>A</b></td>
<td>is the cost of a removal from the member’s housing benefit location to their next housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><b>B</b></td>
<td>is the cost of a removal from the member’s housing benefit location to the location specified in the member’s next posting order.<br><b>Note:</b> If the outcome is less than $0, the member is not eligible to receive the amount.</td>

###### 6.5.29 Removal between residences in the same location in Australia

| 1. | A member in the situation in an item in column A of the following table is eligible for the benefit in column B of the same item. |
|---|---|

| Item | Column A<br>Member situation | Column B<br>Benefit |

<td colspan="3">This section applies to a member who has unaccompanied resident family and no accompanied resident family.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>1A.</td>
<td colspan="3">If the member receives a removal under subsection 6.5.46.3 table item 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 — the member is eligible for a removal for their unaccompanied resident family between the following locations.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">The unaccompanied resident family’s family benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">The location the member received their removal to under subsection 6.5.46.3.<br><b>Note:</b> The location the unaccompanied resident family receive a removal to does not become a family benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>1B.</td>
<td colspan="3">If the member receives a removal under subsection 6.5.46.3 table item 6 — the member is eligible for a removal between the following locations.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">From one of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>If it is for the member — from the housing benefit location or the family benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>If it is for the unaccompanied resident family — from the family benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">To the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>If the member and their unaccompanied resident family are to relocate overseas — the Australian capital city that is the nearest port of exit to the overseas location the member has nominated to live following ceasing continuous full-time service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The location in Australia the member has nominated to live following ceasing continuous full-time service.<br><b>Note:</b> The location the unaccompanied resident family receive a removal to does not become a family benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="3">A removal under this section is subject to the same conditions and limitations in column D of the table in subsection 6.5.46.3 that would have applied had the removal been undertaken under the relevant item of that table.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.47 Removal if service continues after intended date of ceasing

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">This section applies to a member who had a removal in advance of ceasing continuous full-time service and continues to serve beyond the date notified in their discharge authority.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the member’s next posting is to a new housing benefit location, the member is eligible for a removal that is limited to what a removal would cost between the following locations.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member’s housing benefit location immediately before the removal in advance of ceasing continuous full-time service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The member’s new housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td><b>Note:</b> If the family remain in the location, the location does not become a family benefit location, as defined in section 1.3.12.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">Subsection 2 does not apply if any of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member was granted a compassionate removal for their resident family to a family benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The removal in advance of ceasing continuous full-time service corresponds with a regular removal on posting during the final 12 months of the member’s service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member must pay a contribution towards the cost of the removal if the cost of the removal to the new housing benefit location is greater than the cost of the removal between the locations specified under subsection 2.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>5.</td>
<td colspan="2">The contribution is calculated using the following formula.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">[image: Start formula contribution equals A minus B end formula]</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">Where:</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><b>A</b></td>
<td>is the cost of a removal from the member’s housing benefit location to the location on the member’s new posting order.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><b>B</b></td>
<td>is the cost of a removal between the locations specified under subsection 2.</td>
</tr>
</table>

##### Division 7: Storage of furniture and effects

###### 6.5.50 Purpose

|  | This Division sets out members' eligibility for storage of their furniture and effects. |
|---|---|

###### 6.5.50A Member this Division does not apply to

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">This Division does not apply to a member who is on any of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Transition location (medical) agreement.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Transition location (general) agreement.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.51 Period for which storage is provided – general

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member's eligibility for storage starts on the date items are first put into storage.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member's storage eligibility will be reviewed under section 6.5.63 on the earliest of the following dates.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The date of the member's next removal under this Determination.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Three years from the date the items were first put into storage.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">If it is reasonable, all furniture and effects stored under this Determination are stored in the nearest available approved store in the location the member leaves.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.52 Storage for members who have accompanied resident family or recognised other persons

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">The following table sets out the storage benefits for a member who meets one of the following and is eligible for a removal under this Chapter.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>They are a member who has accompanied resident family and no unaccompanied resident family.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>They are a member who has recognised other persons and no resident family.</td>
</tr>
</table>

| Item | If a residence in the new location is… | then the member is eligible for the storage of… |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | not available | all their furniture and effects. |
| 2. | a. not available in a suitable size, and<br>b. the member finds a furnished or partly furnished residence | furniture and effects that are not needed in the residence or cannot be housed in it. |
| 3. | a. not available in a suitable size, and<br>b. the member finds an unfurnished residence that cannot house all their furniture and effects | the furniture and effects that the CDF considers cannot reasonably be housed in the residence. The CDF must consider all of the following.<br>a. The size of home that the member's standard housing benefit applies to. This size is a reasonable limit to use in working out what items are reasonable to store in each of the following storage options.<br>i. The residence the member has been allocated or has chosen to rent.<br>ii. Storage at Commonwealth expense.<br>iii. Storage at the member's own cost.<br>b. Items that are the same as non-portable items in the residence. |
| 4. | their own home | a. items of furniture the CDF is satisfied are the same as non-portable items in the home<br>b. furniture and effects under the conditions described in Division 4 subsection 6.5.29.1, table item 4. |
| 5. | an inner-city residence (‘Defence Choice housing’) | the furniture and effects the CDF considers cannot reasonably be housed in the residence. The CDF must consider all of the following.<br>a. The size of home that the member's standard housing benefit applies to. This size is a reasonable limit to use in working out what items are reasonable to store in each of the following storage options.<br>i. The residence the member has chosen.<br>ii. Storage at Commonwealth expense.<br>iii. Storage at the member's own cost.<br>b. Items that are the same as non-portable items in the residence. |

<table>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member ceases to be eligible for storage if they reject an offer of a suitable Service residence and they become ineligible to receive temporary accommodation allowance or rent allowance.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member is not eligible for storage for items not already in storage if all of the following apply.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>They occupy suitable accommodation.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>They are not eligible for a removal under Division 4 section 6.5.29.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>They move at their own expense to alternative accommodation in the same housing benefit location.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="2">For storage benefits when a member is posted to a remote location, see Division 4 section 6.5.37.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.53 Member who has unaccompanied resident family and no accompanied resident family

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="3">This section applies to a member who meets all the following conditions.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td colspan="2">They meet all of the following.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>They have unaccompanied resident family.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>They have no accompanied resident family.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td colspan="2">They are deployed for 6 months or longer.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td colspan="2">They meet any of the following conditions.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>i.</td>
<td>They choose to vacate their accommodation under any of subsections 7.4.23.2, 7.6.38.2, section 7.7.11 or subsection 7.8.31.2.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>ii.</td>
<td>The member must leave the living-in accommodation under subsection 7.4.23.5.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td>iii.</td>
<td>They are occupying an own home and they choose to vacate it for the duration of the deployment.</td>

<tr>

</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.54 Member who has no resident family or recognised other persons

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">This section applies to a member who meets all of the following.</td>
</tr>

<td>a.</td>
<td>They have no resident family or recognised other persons.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>

|---|---|---|
| 1. | The member lives out and is eligible for rent allowance. | Storage of the furniture and effects that the CDF is satisfied cannot reasonably be housed in the residence. |

The member is directed to vacate their living-in accommodation. | Storage of their furniture and effects until the member is rehoused after the deployment.<br>**Note:** For storage of vehicles and towable items on deployment see section 6.5A.19. |

<td></td>

<tr>
<td>3.</td>

</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.54AA Posting to a remote location

| 1. | A member who is eligible for a removal to a remote location under section 6.5.37 is eligible for the storage of the furniture and effects which were not removed. |
|---|---|
| 2. | Despite subsection 1, if a member chooses to occupy living-in accommodation in the remote location, they are not eligible for storage of their furniture and effects. |
| 3. | The Commonwealth is not liable for deterioration of furniture stored under tropical conditions. |

###### 6.5.54A Posting to RAAF Base Tindal

| 1. | This section applies to a member who is eligible for a removal under section 6.5.37A.<br>**Note:** Section 6.5.37A provides a removal of furniture and effects for a member posted to RAAF Base Tindal for 6 months or longer if they choose to occupy living-in accommodation. |
|---|---|
| 2. | The member is eligible for storage at the losing location of their furniture and effects that cannot be housed in their living-in accommodation. |

###### 6.5.55 Newly enlisted members

| 1. | A newly enlisted member who is not eligible for a removal is not eligible for the storage of their furniture and effects unless the CDF is satisfied that they cannot store the items with their family. |
|---|---|
| 2. | The eligibility for storage ends when the member becomes eligible for a removal. |

###### 6.5.56 Storage of statutory officer's official Defence vehicle

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>

<td></td>

<td>It does not have enough garage space for the statutory officer's official Defence vehicle and up to 2 other vehicles, owned by the member, their resident family or recognised other persons.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The garage space for the statutory officer's vehicle cannot be made secure.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.57 Members with own home

|  | A member occupying a suitable own home in the housing benefit location or family benefit location is not eligible for storage unless the CDF is satisfied the items of furniture to be stored are the same as non-portable items in their own home.<br>**Note:** A member who has chosen to vacate their own home as a consequence of being deployed for 6 months or longer may be eligible for storage under section 6.5.53. |
|---|---|

<table>

<td>The member is eligible for storage at the time of a new posting.</td>

<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Their eligibility for storage continues under this Division.</td>

<tr>
<td>4.</td>

<tr>
<td>5.</td>

| 3. | a furnished or partly furnished residence | items necessary for furnishing the residence. |

<tr>

<td></td>
<td>b.</td>

<table>
<tr>

<tr>
<td>2.</td>

<td>a.</td>
<td>Request in writing another period of storage.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the member requests another period of storage, the CDF may do any of the following on the review.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Approve another period of storage of up to 3 years for the furniture and effects.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Refuse another period of storage of the furniture and effects.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4.</td>
<td colspan="2">The member can choose any of the following actions for items which will no longer be stored under paragraph 3.b.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Continue to store the items at that location, at the member's expense.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Relocate the items to the member's residence.</td>
</tr>
</table>

###### 6.5.64 Discretion in special circumstances

<table>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="2">A member is eligible for storage costs or the costs of removal to and from storage if the CDF is satisfied that all of the following conditions are met.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>The member is not eligible for the benefit for reasons beyond the member’s control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>The benefit would be consistent with the purposes of this Division.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>The benefit would be a proper use of resources.</td>
</tr>
</table>

##### Division 8: When a member becomes a member who has accompanied resident family or recognised other persons

###### 6.5.65 Purpose

|  | The purpose of this Division is to set out the removal and storage benefits for a member who goes from having no resident family or recognised other persons to having accompanied resident family and no unaccompanied resident family. |
|---|---|

###### 6.5.66 Marriage planned or common household started before posting

<table>
<tr>

<td>They have planned to be married or register their relationship but are posted before their planned event happens.</td>

<td></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">To qualify, the member must provide documentary evidence that they had completed arrangements for the marriage or had started maintaining a common household before they received the posting authority.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member must repay removal assistance provided under subsection 1 in relation to the partner, if that partner does not move to the housing benefit location to join the member.</td>

###### 6.5.67 Removal after posting authority issued

<table>
<tr>

<td></td>
<td>b.</td>

| 1. | If a member serving in Australia marries outside Australia or is recognised as having an ADF recognised partnership in a location outside Australia, the removal benefits provided under section 6.5.68 apply. |
|---|---|

<td>3.</td>

<tr>
<td>4.</td>

<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">[image: Start formula contribution equals A minus B end formula]</td>

<tr>
<td></td>
<td colspan="3">Where:</td>

<td></td>

##### Division 9: When a member no longer has resident family or recognised other persons

###### 6.5.74 Purpose

|  | This Division sets out removal and storage benefits of a member who ceases to have resident family or recognised other for any reason. |
|---|---|

###### 6.5.75 Member ceases to have any resident family or recognised other persons (other than on death of the resident family or recognised other person)

<table>
<tr>
<td>1.</td>
<td colspan="2">When a member ceases to have any resident family or recognised other persons, they may choose in writing one of these removal options.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>a.</td>
<td>Removal to a location in Australia where they intend to live after ceasing continuous full-time service.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>b.</td>
<td>Removal to the nearest store. Removal from the store will be to where they nominate they will live after ceasing continuous full-time service. Removal will be at the member's request.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>c.</td>
<td>Deferment of the option under paragraph a. until their next posting.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>d.</td>
<td>Deferment of the option under paragraph a. until they leave. This is if their current posting is the final posting before they leave.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2.</td>
<td colspan="2">If the member does not choose an option from subsection 1 above and continues to provide a residence, they are eligible for a removal on the next posting.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3.</td>
<td colspan="2">A member who meets the conditions in an item in column A of the following table when they cease to have any resident family or recognised other persons for reasons other than the death of their resident family or recognised other persons is eligible for the benefit in column B of the same item.</td>
</tr>
</table>

| Item | Column A<br>Condition | Column B<br>Benefit |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | The member was occupying a furnished residence with their resident family and recognised other persons and has furniture and effects in storage at Commonwealth expense at another location. | Continued storage for another 3 months. |
| 2. | The member was a member who had unaccompanied resident family and no accompanied resident family. | Three months’ storage for items already in storage and for items removed into storage at Commonwealth expense at a location other than the housing benefit location. |

|  | **Note:** A member who has received a removal benefit under this section does not limit eligibility for a removal under Chapter 6 Part 5 Division 6 when they cease continuous full-time service. |
|---|---|

###### 6.5.75A Member ceases to have resident family or recognised other persons – death of resident family or recognised other persons

<table>
